errors.error_description: Assigned a wider vector (count with ADDR_BITS+1 bits) to a narrower output (level with ADDR_BITS bits), causing truncation.
Declared an internal signal (unused_flag) that is never read or driven anywhere in the module.
Assigned to a sequentially-updated register (dout_reg) inside an always_comb block, mixing combinational and sequential domains.
Used a mismatched named block end label (end : ptr_update_wrong) for a begin block labeled ptr_update.
